breakdown.method: Batch score = lowest key score (07-judge.md; config.score_rule). Each key scored on five axes: accuracy 30, nativeness 30, termbase/transliteration/orthography 20, fit for the Urdu-speaking traveller 10, structure 10. The axes below are those of the lowest key, dining.alkoot-hotel.blurb (unchanged since round 1; they sum to its 91). Source defects are recorded, not deducted. Round 2 re-scored the four edited keys.
